description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter application. It defines the `main()` function that initializes and runs the app, along with a `MyApp` widget that sets up the MaterialApp with theme, routing, and initial route configurations.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: A stateless widget that configures the root of the Flutter application, setting theme, initial route, and route generation logic.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The application's entry point which runs the Flutter app using `MyApp` as the root widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the `MyApp` widget, returning a configured `MaterialApp`.
